info.title: Track Children - Mobile Growth API
info.description: API growth triển khai ngày 29/10/2026 theo docs/core_growth; backend và repository Flutter remote đã có mã và kiểm thử tích hợp HTTP. Sáu operations cho giao diện growth mới. JSON camelCase, base /api/v1, current mobile Bearer session. PostgreSQL chỉ growth.measurements/evaluations; WHO static, velocity on read. Input kg/cm; BMI và Z từ backend normalization/anthro. Synthetic examples illustrate contract, not verified WHO reference datasets. No automatic demo-data upload. Runtime data still respects mapping review gates. Deployment/device QA and existing auth migration issues are tracked in GROWTH-RUNTIME-README.md.

get.summary: Tổng quan bốn nhóm tăng trưởng
get.description: Authorized snapshot of child context and exactly four cards. latest is independent of date filters; sparkline uses the effective range. Authentication uses the current mobile session, no growth-specific login. Read computation has a cumulative 15-second R execution budget plus a bounded 2-second queue wait. Process at most 128 days per R batch, prioritize selected/latest days, and mark remaining misses PENDING_CALCULATION. Release DB locks during R; bound total HTTP work to 20 seconds, with explicit client timeout at least 30 seconds. No unlimited 5-year synchronous recomputation. Repeated GETs may warm reproducible cache, never mutate raw measurements.

Cache-Control.description: All child-specific responses are private and not stored by shared caches.

get.summary: Chi tiết, lịch sử, biểu đồ và đánh giá
get.description: All active readings/samples in range, no pagination that silently truncates chart history. Same-day pairs only. For weight, primary WFA plus a WFL/WFH scatter; other metrics return one age chart. Filters never change Z/classification. Seven SD curves only from verified data, segmented at day 731 where applicable. Exact evidence may be empty even if R assessment is valid. selected point assessment/content matches its IDs and snapshot. Missing paired data keeps raw history, bmi samples absent, and an explicit NOT_ASSESSABLE/MISSING_PAIRED_MEASUREMENT for affected eligible primary IDs. Read computation has a cumulative 15-second R execution budget plus a bounded 2-second queue wait. get.summary: Tốc độ thực tế và đối chiếu WHO theo kỳ
get.description: Actual intervals use consecutive readings from full active history before filtering end dates; keep predecessor outside viewport. Actual unit g/month or cm/month uses 30.4375 days. Each actual pair may be annotated against the unique exact source row for its own dates, without changing the pair or drawing a WHO overlay in actual mode. WHO intervals have separate IDs, full-interval units g/cm, exact DOB calendar-month or 28-day anchors, correct sex/age/period. No rate overlay with interval gains. who mode requires intervalMonths; actual mode forbids it and returns whoIntervals=[]. With fewer than two valid readings return INSUFFICIENT_MEASUREMENTS/NOT_REQUESTED and no bars. With valid actual rate but no exact pair, return READY/NO_EXACT_REFERENCE. Missing/unverified sources and >=24-month end ages use their distinct statuses. Never issue REFERENCE_LOW/HIGH/MIDDLE/EXTREME or a velocity diagnosis. Read computation has a cumulative 15-second R execution budget plus a bounded 2-second queue wait. Process at most 128 days per R batch, prioritize selected/latest days, and mark remaining misses PENDING_CALCULATION. Release DB locks during R; bound total HTTP work to 20 seconds, with explicit client timeout at least 30 seconds. No unlimited 5-year synchronous recomputation. Repeated GETs may warm reproducible cache, never mutate raw measurements.

put.summary: Lưu hoặc cập nhật một phần số đo trong ngày
put.description: Requires edit. Atomically upsert only supplied metrics, partial unique active(child,metric,measured_on). Repeating payload preserves active IDs; omitted fields stay unchanged. Null metrics rejected; use DELETE for removal. Validate before commit. Parent child row lock serializes writers; invalidate dependent evaluations in same transaction. Run R outside transaction, check input fingerprint under lock before publishing. Once saved, return 200 measurementSaved=true even if R times out; never resurrect stale cache or ask client to submit again. Date changes are not supported by this PUT: it writes the path day, does not move an existing ID. Existing date correction requires a separately designed move operation, not automatic delete/reinsert. Read computation has a cumulative 15-second R execution budget plus a bounded 2-second queue wait. Process at most 128 days per R batch, prioritize selected/latest days, and mark remaining misses PENDING_CALCULATION. Release DB locks during R; bound total HTTP work to 20 seconds, with explicit client timeout at least 30 seconds. No unlimited 5-year synchronous recomputation. Repeated GETs may warm reproducible cache, never mutate raw measurements.

delete.description: Requires edit. Verify child ownership and access before looking up record. In one child-locked transaction soft-delete and invalidate all evaluations depending on primary or paired FK; no R execution needed. Same authorized already-deleted ID returns 204. Nonexistent/other-child/no-view is 404, view-only is 403. Re-adding same metric/day creates a new active ID. Reload overview/detail/velocity after success; absence of response body is expected.

204.description: Deletion committed or already deleted; no body.

Cache-Control.description: All child-specific responses are private and not stored by shared caches.

MobileBearer.description: Existing parent mobile auth session; server checks token and current account/session plus child scope growth.

Scope.description: Effective business-day range [startOn,endBefore), clipped to birth, today and the exclusive 60-calendar-month birthday. endBefore may equal startOn for an empty effective range.

ResponseMeta.description: A single consistent snapshot. snapshotToken is opaque, not sortable. engineBundleId=null when the R runtime is unavailable. calculationPending reports unfinished cache misses, not a failed measurement save.

text.const: Nội dung giải thích hiện chưa sẵn có.

ContentBlock.description: Only APPROVED templates may produce READY. Failed lookup/review/missing data uses the fixed fallback; never substitute another classification. adviceCode is for advice deduplication, null for comments.

overview.description: Weight overview sentence selected by indicator and classification; display with approved advice.

sourceStandard.description: WHO-2007 for HCFA; WHO-2006 for the other attained indicators.

IndicatorAssessment.description: Z is the unchanged public anthro 1.1.0 output (already rounded to 2 decimals). READY may have null classification when its mapping is not approved; then cacheTag=null. A flag/policy failure only removes the affected indicators, not other valid indicators on the day.

Normalization.description: Normalized by the 731-day anthro boundary, not calendar-month display labels or raw cmeasure. c9mo_flag=1 disallows height-based assessment even if R returns finite numbers.

Measurement.description: Raw active measurement only. measuredOn is Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh business date. Deleted rows are excluded. IDs, not names/indexes, identify points.

MetricSample.description: Value/normalization calculated by backend. BMI and weight-for-size use the same active-day weight/height pair. No client-side re-pairing or raw-height BMI. A sample may have unavailable assessments.

ChartPoint.description: x/y must equal the selected chart units and normalization. measurementId+pairedMeasurementId+indicator is the stable selection key; duplicate x at different dates must remain distinct. assessment is the entry for this chart in assessments.

ReferenceSegment.description: LHFA/BMIFA split at 731 days. Never join curves/child series across the normalization boundary. Draw-only interpolation within a curve/segment is not an assessment or exact SD evidence.

ChartReference.description: Missing file: importStatus=null/reason=MISSING_REFERENCE_FILE, no curves. Non-VERIFIED imports never supply overlays. Numeric R assessments can remain READY independently.

Warning.description: status/reason must belong to the named namespace in the status contract; no undocumented widget-only codes.

Evidence.description: Exact official SD values at this x/basis/version only. Do not present interpolated display curves as exact reference evidence. Empty evidence does not invalidate a public R Z-score.

Chart.description: Six attained-growth charts; WFL/WFH are scatter (x=cm,y=kg), not age plots. No synthetic y=0 WHO coordinates. Filter changes viewport, not classifications.

VelocityCapability.description: Supported periods, not a promise of a match for every age. Weight 1-month and head 2/3-month tables end at 12 months. Length/head do not support period 1. Product WHO comparison requires end age below 24 calendar months.

OverviewCard.description: latest uses all active history independent of the sparkline date filter. No average Z-score.

OverviewResponse.description: Exactly one card for each metric; absent values are latest=null and sparkline=[].

MetricDetailResponse.description: Full data in the effective date range (no hidden pagination). BMI includes its source raw measurements. Weight returns WFA plus the requested/default WFL or WFH chart, even empty. Other metrics return one age chart. Per-chart datasets and source metadata must share this snapshot.

DayResponse.description: An empty day is 200 with measurements=[], bmi=null, assessments=[]. No fake pending evaluation without a primary measurement. At most WFA/LHFA/HCFA/BMIFA plus one WFL/H.

SaveDayRequest.description: Partial-day upsert. At least one non-null metric. kg/cm only; no manual age/BMI/Z/unit/IDs. note absent preserves notes, null clears; applies only to supplied metrics. measuredAt if supplied must have a timezone, match path business day and not be in the future. If omitted preserve existing row timestamp, or use local midnight for a new row as a date-only convention, not recovered actual time.

SaveDayResponse.description: 200 even when R is unavailable after commit. Repeat same values keeps active IDs and may yield changedMetrics=[]. Never report a committed measurement as an unsuccessful save because assessment failed.

MatchedVelocityReference.description: Full-interval increments in g or cm, including negative/zero published values and ties. intervalMonths=null for mixed week/month rows. Only verified source and exact calendar/week anchors; no interpolation or division into monthly rates.

content.description: Null after the 24-month calendar birthday: record actual changes only, with no velocity interpretation or advice.

VelocityInterval.description: Actual rate = full-interval delta / elapsedDays * 30.4375. Do not round before calculation. Negative and zero increments remain valid numeric observations. REFERENCE_MATCHED is not a healthy/unhealthy classification; Z may still be unavailable.

VelocityTrend.description: Only two consecutive non-overlapping actual intervals with same basis/units. Compare unrounded actual rates; UNCHANGED means exact equality, no implicit epsilon. rateDifference is magnitude, not signed change.

referenceIntervals.description: All verified WHO rows for the requested sex and period, independent of available measurements; values are full-interval g/cm, not monthly rates.

incrementComparison.description: Signed difference of full-interval increments in adjacent non-overlapping WHO periods; independent of normalized monthly-rate trend.

content.description: Null after the 24-month calendar birthday: record actual changes only, with no velocity interpretation or advice.

VelocityResponse.description: Actual list is built from consecutive active readings before filtering by interval end date. WHO list is separate and may use different pairs or overlap. Selecting a WHO pair never changes actual latest rate. No exact match is 200 with reason, not a fabricated WHO Z-score.

ErrorResponse.description: Transport/request failures only; follows auth error envelope. Engine/reference/content failures normally stay in successful data responses.

ChildId.name: childId
ChildId.description: Real authorized child UUID, never a display name or local demo ID.

VelocityMetric.name: metric
VelocityMetric.description: BMI velocity is not a supported operation; bmi is a 422 INVALID_METRIC request.

MeasuredOn.name: measuredOn
MeasuredOn.description: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh business date. Cannot precede birth, be future, or be on/after the 60-month birthday.

StartOn.name: startOn
StartOn.description: Inclusive date. Default birth date; effective range clipped to product scope. A supplied startOn must be before a supplied endBefore.

EndBefore.name: endBefore
EndBefore.description: Exclusive date. Default min(tomorrow business date,60-month birthday). Clipping can produce an empty effective range.

SelectedMeasurementId.name: selectedMeasurementId
SelectedMeasurementId.description: Optional primary ID within the effective range. Belongs to this child and requested metric (weight for BMI). Missing/deleted/other-child ID is 404; an authorized ID outside this metric/range is 422. Default newest visible point.

WeightForSizeIndicator.name: weightForSizeIndicator
WeightForSizeIndicator.description: Only for metric=weight. Default branch of newest visible same-day pair by age_days; if none, branch by child current age. Explicit branch returns only eligible pairs for that branch, never converts WFL into WFH to force a match.

StatureView.name: statureView
StatureView.description: Only weight detail secondary scatter. Anchor is newest eligible pair in branch; clip reference viewport to the official cm domain. Does not change assessment or discard primary WFA history.

IntervalMonths.name: intervalMonths
IntervalMonths.description: Required in who mode, forbidden in actual mode. Unsupported metric/period combination is 422 INVALID_VALUE; a supported period with no matching pair is 200 NO_EXACT_REFERENCE. Head/length period 1 unsupported; weight period 1 preserves its first mixed week/month rows.

Unauthorized.description: Missing/invalid/expired/revoked mobile access. Refresh through existing auth; no growth token store.

Cache-Control.description: All child-specific responses are private and not stored by shared caches.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but view-only for this edit, or account unavailable.

Cache-Control.description: All child-specific responses are private and not stored by shared caches.

NotFound.description: Child/measurement missing or no view permission. Do not reveal another child exists.

Cache-Control.description: All child-specific responses are private and not stored by shared caches.

ValidationError.description: Malformed fields/query or semantic date/metric/position error. error.fields identifies fields; specific request codes may be used.

DatabaseUnavailable.description: Database unavailable before confirmed completion, or AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED from the existing auth readiness dependency. A transport timeout does not prove a mutation rolled back; reconcile using GET day before resubmission.
